```javascript
function SearchInput() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const timeoutRef = useRef(null);

  const handleSearch = useCallback((value) => {
    // API call here
    console.log('Searching for:', value);
  }, []);

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    setQuery(value);
    
    clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      handleSearch(value);
    }, 300); // 300ms delay
  };

  return <input onChange={handleChange} value={query} placeholder="Search..." />;
}
```

**How it works:** clears previous timeout on each keystroke, fires API call only after 300ms of inactivity. Replace `300` for different delay, `handleSearch` to point to your actual API.

**Alternative (hook):** extract into `useDebounce`:

```javascript
function useDebounce(callback, delay) {
  const timeoutRef = useRef(null);
  
  return useCallback((...args) => {
    clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => callback(...args), delay);
  }, [callback, delay]);
}

// Usage:
const debouncedSearch = useDebounce((value) => console.log('API:', value), 300);
<input onChange={(e) => debouncedSearch(e.target.value)} />
```
